product_from_film: Huxe offers personal audio content through a phone app.
explains_well: The shift from mass-media crowds to individual listeners makes the personal-content promise easy to understand.
unclear: The film never shows which interests or sources shape the personal feed, so personalization remains a promise rather than a visible process.

lessons.keep: Make the audience change visible through group and individual scenes.
